items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: The interviewee discusses Jim Robbins only in the context of Bunk Johnson telling him to take lessons from Vic Gasper; the interviewee does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction with Jim Robbins.

ctx.x: Well, very good. Did you hear him play in those years?

What, those years? I used to hear him play all the time at the Palace Theater. He used to play at the Palace Theater when Vic was playing the lyric, but he used to take lessons. You know, learn more. I learned more about it, you know. Yeah. That's like Jim, you know. That's like Jim, you know. Told him to go back and take lessons from Vic. Yeah. Well, Jack Teagarden used to take lessons from Vic too. Yeah. I like that. Vic Gasper was a good musician. He must have been one of the great ones. Yeah, one of the great…
He was fairly strict, was he?
